nodes.label: Fault F44.1 — two gates specified against modules with no entry point
Gate 80 — the Löwdin bridge D_of equality gate
A module with no entry point does not fail its gate, it fails to be a gate
nodes.rationale: t7e_probe.py has no __main__ block, so running it as a script performs imports and exits 0 having compared nothing. rc=0 is the only signal a gate block records, so the gate passes silently and a future diff of gate logs reads byte-identity as reproduction. Gate 80's AttributeError is under-specified but safe because it fails loudly. The exit code of a Python module executed as a script is a statement about the import system, not about physics — and §4.6 says a pass is evidence only if the check can fail.

nodes.label: Record, never repair: no sealed file is edited (the F44.1 route)
nodes.rationale: A fault is entered beside the sealed artefact rather than correcting it in place, so the record of what was claimed and when survives; later sessions cite the fault file and the sealed bytes continue to verify.
